title: Did you guys try Kronos?
author: Tricky-Long7757
selftext: Today I tried this, speaking from a technical analysis perspective the context window(suggested on X) might not be enough to draw meaningful predictions. Even for regime detection algos like PELT the predicted output or the context window of the model is too small to work with. If you guys ever tried this or you have any ideas of how differently this can be used, please feel free to share. I would like to try and share the results if it is possible.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
I'd check its pretraining dates before the context window. if your test bars sit inside what it learned from, every forecast there is look-ahead in disguise, so only score it on bars after its cutoff. keeping a model blind to later bars was the hard part when I built Quantradin, which replays rules over market history on paper, free. quantradin.com

were your PELT runs on bars after its cutoff?
